Free Stock Photo & Video License - Pexels

name: Pexels
summary: Library of free stock photos and videos, free to download and use without attribution.
description: Stock photo and video platform: browse millions of royalty-free photos and videos by search, trending terms, collections and wallpapers, all free to use. The Pexels license allows editing and commercial, print and social use without attribution, but forbids selling unaltered copies or redistributing files on other stock platforms; an image and video API, iOS/Android apps and Figma, Sketch, Chrome, Google Slides and MS Office integrations bring the library into other tools.
